title: Fix file picker export and getPath; add onError, bookmarks and web save dialog
body:
## Description

Fixes four file picker bugs found while building Save As in Annodoc. Also adds a few things picked up from comparing Calf with FileKit, which are cheap to add before 1.0.0.

### Bug fixes

- **Android save wrote a 0-byte file.** The bytes or file to save were held in a plain `remember`, which was lost while the save sheet was open. They now live in `rememberSaveable`, so a file source also survives process death. The created document gets a real MIME type from its extension, writes use mode `"wt"`, and a failed write deletes the empty document.
- **iOS export name had a `<UUID>-` prefix** (cherry-pick of `2145426`). Staged files now go into `tmp/<area>/<UUID>/<name>`, so the sheet offers the requested name.
- **iOS export moved the source file** (also from `2145426`). The export sheet now uses `asCopy = true` and says "Save", not "Move".
- **`KmpFile.getPath()` wasn't a filesystem path on mobile.** It now returns a decoded filesystem path or `null`:
  - Android returns a path only for `file:` URIs; content URIs give `null`.
  - iOS returns the path of the readable copy.
  - The new `KmpFile.toUriString()` gives the URI that `getPath()` used to return.
- **iOS swipe-dismiss mid-animation was never reported.** A shared `DocumentPickerDelegate` handles both delegate protocols and reports the result exactly once.
- **iOS picked copies lost their names.** Picked files keep their original names.
- **Android didn't report a missing documents app.** An `ActivityNotFoundException` now goes to `onError` instead of crashing.

### New API

- **`onError: (FilePickerException) -> Unit`** on `rememberFilePickerLauncher` and `rememberFileSaverLauncher`, on every platform. The old overloads stay and delegate: the picker ignores errors, and the saver reports `null` as before.
  - If some picked files can't be read, `onError` fires once, then `onResult` gets the files that could be read.
- **`FilePickerSettings(initialDirectory: KmpFile?)`** opens dialogs in a folder the user picked. On iOS this uses `directoryURL`.
- **New `KmpFile` functions:**
  - `KmpFile.fromUriString(…)` rebuilds a file from `toUriString()` or from an absolute path.
  - `getSize()` and `getMimeType()`.
- **Bookmarks:** `createBookmark()`, `KmpFile.fromBookmark(…)` and `releaseBookmark()` keep access to picked files across restarts.
  - Android persists URI permissions.
  - iOS stores a bookmark and holds security-scoped access on the resolved URL until release (FileKit #667).
  - Desktop stores the absolute path; the web has no bookmarks.
- **Web save dialog:** the saver uses `showSaveFilePicker` where the browser has it (Chromium), and falls back to `<a download>` in Safari and Firefox.

### Behaviour change

`getPath()` on Android and iOS no longer returns a URI string. If you relied on that, switch to `toUriString()`. `docs/filepicker.md` has a migration note.

## Related Issue

None on GitHub. These were reported from Annodoc's Save As work.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] New feature
- [x] Improvement
- [x] Documentation update
- [x] Build/CI change (Robolectric + Compose UI test deps for Android host tests)

## Platforms Tested

- [x] Android: host tests (Robolectric), plus a manual pass on a Pixel 9 emulator (API 35)
- [x] iOS: simulator unit tests, plus a UI pass on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator (iOS 26.2), driven with XCUITest
- [x] Desktop: unit tests
- [x] Web: the Wasm sample in a Chromium browser, with `showSaveFilePicker` stubbed (see below)

### Tests added

- **calf-io:**
  - Desktop: path, metadata and bookmark tests.
  - iOS: path (7), metadata (6), bookmark (4).
  - Android: `KmpFile` (8), bookmark (5).
- **calf-file-picker:**
  - Android: saver launcher (10), picker launcher (4), initial directory (2).
  - iOS: picker delegate, staging, initial directory, `stagePickedUrls`.
  - Desktop: initial directory, partial-failure message.

### Android emulator pass

- [x] Export writes a valid 374×374 PNG (32,417 bytes), stored as `image/png`.
- [x] Cancelling the save sheet reports a cancel.
- [x] A picked file shows `null` from `getPath()` and a content URI from `toUriString()`, plus the right size and MIME type, and can be read as a stream.
- [x] A folder bookmark holds a persisted read+write grant, which is still there after the app's process is killed.

### iOS simulator pass

- [x] The save sheet offers `profile_picture` (extension hidden by the sheet) and says "Save", not "Move". The file lands as `profile_picture.png`, a valid 318×318 PNG, and the saver's staging folder is emptied.
- [x] Swiping the save sheet down reports "Save cancelled", both after it settles and while it is still sliding in. Swipes 40–200 ms after the sheet starts appearing, in 20 ms steps, were all reported; none dismissed silently.
- [x] With a picked folder as the initial directory, the picker opens in that folder. That holds even after a pick from another folder, which moves the system's remembered location. After Reset, it follows the remembered location again.
- [x] A file picked there shows its original name, a readable-copy path (`tmp/calf-file-picker/<UUID>/notes.txt`), `25 bytes · text/plain`, and streams.

The iOS 26 save sheet has no Cancel button; swiping down is how it is dismissed.

### Web pass (Wasm sample, Chromium, save picker stubbed)

- [x] Save: Calf calls `showSaveFilePicker` with `suggestedName: profile_picture.png` and an `image/png` / `.png` type, writes the PNG (1,073 bytes) and reports "Saved successfully".
- [x] Cancel (`AbortError`) reports "Save cancelled".
- [x] A refused picker (`SecurityError`, e.g. no user gesture) falls back to a download of `profile_picture.png`.
- [x] Without `showSaveFilePicker` (Safari, Firefox) the file is downloaded, and its blob URL is still readable 2 s after the click.

### Still to check

- [ ] Chrome's own save dialog by hand (the stub covers Calf's side only).
- [ ] Safari: Export Photo downloads the file.

## Checklist

- [x] Builds successfully on all targeted platforms
- [ ] Verified UI behavior across at least one mobile and one desktop target (Android and iOS done; desktop UI not checked by hand)
- [x] Updated documentation/examples if the API or usage changed
- [ ] Confirmed no breaking changes without proper deprecation notice (`getPath()` on mobile changes meaning, see above)
